name: Pierre et Vacances SA
summary: Pierre et Vacances SA engages in the property development and tourism businesses in Europe and internationally. The company operates apartments, detached houses, aparthotels, and cottages, as well as residences, villages, and hotels. It also offers its products under the Pierre & Vacances, Center Parcs, Sunparks, Villages, maeva, and Adagio brands. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
